principles: Membership should feel like joining a community around African creativity.
Explain what members unlock for storytellers, not just what they unlock for themselves.
Prioritize accessibility in the rest-of-world (ROW) context with flexible pricing.

tiers.name: Free
benefits: A limited number of stories each month
Access to selected newsletters and updates

tiers.name: Supporter
benefits: Unlimited access to stories and collections
Invites to online conversations and AMAs

ui_patterns.name: SoftMeterBanner
copyPatterns: You’re exploring African stories. {remaining} free stories left this month.
Members help keep this work independent across the continent.

ui_patterns.name: HardPaywallInline
copyPatterns: You’ve reached your free story limit.
Become a member to keep exploring African stories without limits.

flows.name: ArticleAccessFlowROW
flows.description: Decides if a ROW user can read an article, sees meter, or sees paywall.

integration_hints.configRole: This file should be treated as the canonical membership config for ROW; Atlantic-inspired file is reference only.

reactUsage.logic: Read tiers, ui_patterns, and flows.decisionModel to decide when and how to show meter or paywall.
